The Venue

A farmhouse escape, minutes from the city

Grand Orchid Farmhouse sits on Main Raiwind Road near Dubai Town, Lahore — a green, open-air farmhouse venue known for its lush landscape and rustic-chic wedding style. Away from packed city marquees, it gives your event room to breathe: lawns, trees and sky as your backdrop.

Please note: this is Grand Orchid Farmhouse on Raiwind Road — a separate venue from Grand Orchid Marquees by Mughal-e-Azam in DHA EME.

Celebrate Here

Events at the farmhouse

One green setting, three very different moods — colour and dholki on the lawn, a golden-hour baraat, and a walima under the lights.

Mehndi

Colourful drapes, marigolds and dholki on the grass — the farmhouse lawn is made for a loud, joyful mehndi with family gathered all around.

Wedding · Baraat

A rustic-chic baraat in the open air — floral arches, rows of chairs on the lawn and the farmhouse greenery framing the couple's big moment.

Walima

As the sun sets, the farmhouse turns golden — fairy lights overhead, dinner on the lawn and a calm, elegant close to the celebrations.

Gallery

The farmhouse mood

Wide lawns, mature trees and open sky — the natural setting that makes farmhouse weddings feel different from a city hall.
